verdictSemantics.FAIL: the declared construction scope executed and the observed outcome contradicted the frozen THEN (an interrupted run was duplicated or rebound, a replay minted a second decision or receipt, a drifted package was accepted or the restoration did not resume the same run, a stale attempt/writer receipt landed, a second writer or a stale revision was accepted, or the case module reported failures)
verdictSemantics.NOT-EXERCISED: a prerequisite was missing (registered recipe, schema-valid definition, frozen pilot baseline, identity or environment — e.g. the pinned 0.5.0 Comet build is absent, or a kill window could not be landed within the bounded attempt budget); structured refusal with nonzero exit, never converted into a pass
